model: dry-basis, coupled effective heat and moisture; no explicit latent heat

geometry.beyond_observation: hold final radius, not used by primary endpoint

environment: 0..4h piecewise linear; thereafter arithmetic mean of last-hour 61 observations
boundary_moisture: equivalent dry-basis scale; no invented equilibrium/activity/film relation
criterion: max over the current material domain C < 0.15; 1D evaluated polynomial maximum and matched-model 2D geometry check
numerical_allowance: derived from actual spectral, time-method and independent FV differences in finalize_q4.py; not a rigorous physical error bound
